phase_name: Tests for Every Refusal Case and the No-Self-Approval Structure

objectives.description: chmod +x all four, declare in provides.scripts, confirm run-all.sh discovery

approaches_tried.approach: comment-only diff fixture with a removed '-- comment' line using only 2 leading dashes
approaches_tried.reason: A removed line whose CONTENT itself starts with '--' needs 3 total leading characters in the diff line (1 diff marker + 2 comment dashes); 2 dashes stripped to 1 dash + spaces, which failed the boilerplate-line matcher and misclassified as declaration-level. Fixed by using 3 leading dashes in the fixture AND hardening approve-classify.sh's diff parser to skip '---'/'+++' file-header lines only positionally (before the first '@@' hunk marker), never by shape alone, since shape-based matching collides with a real removed/added '--'-prefixed comment line.
